customMethods.name: createTraceGraph
customMethods.script:
'''
		Generates nodes and edges needed to form the trace graph's schema
		Args:
			lotTraceData (dataset)
		Returns:
			'nodes': list of node objects
			'edges': list of edge objects
		Updated:
			jz  9/23/24 9:37am Created
			jfc 12/15/25: Added fix in detectCycle whe previousLotNodeId is not found		
	'''
	########################################################################
	def createLoeNode(nodeInfo):
		# Check to see if operation event node already exists. If not, we create it
		
		loeNodeId = "oe-%s"%str(nodeInfo['lotOperationEventId']) 
		if processedNodes.has_key(loeNodeId): return processedNodes[loeNodeId]
				
		operationtStamp = system.date.format(system.date.addMinutes(nodeInfo['operationtStamp'], deviceUTCOffsetMins), "yy-MM-dd HH:mm")
		loeStyle = {'color': system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(nodeInfo['lotOperationColor']), 'backgroundColor': nodeInfo['lotOperationColor']} if nodeInfo['lotOperationColor'] else {}
		userInfo = {'text': nodeInfo['createdByUser'], 'style': {}} if nodeInfo['createdByUser'] != 'SYSTEM' else {'text': '----', 'style': {'color': 'transparent'}}
		assetLine = "%s (%s)"%(nodeInfo['operationAssetName'], nodeInfo['assetTransportName']) if nodeInfo['assetTransportName'] else nodeInfo['operationAssetName']
				
		lineItems = []
		lineItems.append({'text': nodeInfo['lotOperationName'], 'style': {'fontWeight': 'bold'}})	#title
		lineItems.append({'text': '----', 'style': {'color': 'transparent'}})							#blank
		lineItems.append({'text': operationtStamp, 'style': {}})										#time		
		lineItems.append(userInfo)																		#user
		lineItems.append({'text': assetLine, 'style': {}})												#asset
		
		operationEventNode = {
			'id': loeNodeId,
			'position': {'x': 0, 'y': 0}, 
			'data': {'label': 'Event %s'%nodeInfo['lotOperationEventId'], 'type': 'operation', 'nodeType': 'operation', 'style': loeStyle, 'lines': [line for line in lineItems], 'rawData': nodeInfo},
			'sourcePosition': 'right', 
			'targetPosition': 'left', 
			'type': 'custom'
		}
	
		processedNodes[loeNodeId] = operationEventNode
		
		return operationEventNode
	########################################################################
	def createLotNode(nodeInfo, loeNode, previousLotNodeId):
		
		# Check to see if lot node already exists. If not, we create it. 
		lotAssetStr = buildLotAssetStr(nodeInfo)
		if nodeInfo['itemSourceName'] == 'input':
			lotNodeId = getNodeSource(lotAssetStr)
			previousLotNodeId = lotNodeId
		else:
			seqNum = getSequenceNumber(lotAssetStr)
			if seqNum == 0: targetLotNodeId = lotAssetStr
			elif seqNum == 1:
				targetLotNodeId = '%s-1'%lotAssetStr if detectCycle(loeNode['id'], lotAssetStr, previousLotNodeId) else lotAssetStr
			else: targetLotNodeId = ('%s-%s'%(lotAssetStr, seqNum + 1) if detectCycle(loeNode['id'], '%s-%s'%(lotAssetStr, seqNum), previousLotNodeId) else '%s-%s'%(lotAssetStr, seqNum))
			lotNodeId = targetLotNodeId
		
		if processedNodes.has_key(lotNodeId): return processedNodes[lotNodeId]

		lotNode = {
			'id': lotNodeId,
			'position': {'x': 0, 'y': 0}, 
			'data': {'label': 'Event %s'%nodeInfo['lotId'], 'type': 'lot', 'nodeType': 'lot', 'nodeQty': 0, 'seqNum': getSequenceNumber(lotAssetStr) + 1, 'style': {}, 'lines': [], 'rawData': nodeInfo},
			'sourcePosition': 'right', 
			'targetPosition': 'left', 
			'type': 'custom'
		}
		
		processedNodes[lotNodeId] = lotNode
		
		return lotNode
	########################################################################
	def updateLotNodeDisplay(lotNodeId):
	
		rawData = processedNodes[lotNodeId]['data']['rawData']
		
		lineItems = []
		lineItems.append({'text': '%s'%rawData['lotName'], 'style': {'fontWeight': 'bold'}})	#title		
		
		nodeQty = processedNodes[lotNodeId]['data']['nodeQty']
		
		if nodeQty == 0:
			qtyLine = 'Empty'
			qtyStyle = {}
		else:
			stateLine = rawData['lotStateName'] or '' if rawData['lotStateName'] == rawData['lotStateReasonName'] else rawData['lotStateName'] or '' + ' ' + (rawData['lotStateReasonName'] or '')
			lotState = rawData['lotStateName'] or rawData['lotStateReasonName'] or ''
			qtyStyle = {'color': 'var(--kcRed-60)', 'fontWeight': 'bold'} if 'scrap' in lotState.lower() else {} #will be replaced when we have lotStateColors
			qtyLine = '%s %s %s'%(nodeQty, (rawData['itemUnitName'] or ''), stateLine)
		
		lineItems.append({'text': qtyLine, 'style': qtyStyle})
		
		orderLine = "Order # %s"%rawData['workOrderName'] if rawData['workOrderName'] else 'No Order'
		orderLine = "%s - %s"%(orderLine, rawData['itemName'])
		bgColor = rawData['itemColor'] or 'var(--kcGray-20)' if nodeQty > 0 else 'var(--kcGray-20)'
		lineStyle = {'backgroundColor': bgColor , 'color': system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(bgColor)}
		lineItems.append({'text': orderLine, 'style': lineStyle})		#Production Order
		
		itemDescInfo = {'text': rawData['itemDescription'], 'style': {}} if (rawData['itemDescription'] or None) is not None else {'text': '----', 'style': {'color': 'transparent'}}
		lineItems.append(itemDescInfo)		#Item Description
		
		assetLine = "%s (%s)"%(rawData['operationAssetName'], rawData['assetTransportName']) if rawData['assetTransportName'] else rawData['operationAssetName']		
		lineItems.append({'text': assetLine, 'style': {}})		#Item Description

		processedNodes[lotNodeId]['data']['lines'] = [line for line in lineItems]
		return		
	########################################################################
	def processEvent(itemSourceName, lotNode, loeNode, nodeInfo):
		# we first append the sourceNode, then the targetNode, then create an edge between them
		lotAssetStr = buildLotAssetStr(nodeInfo)
		sourceNode, targetNode = (lotNode, loeNode) if itemSourceName == 'input' else (loeNode, lotNode)
		nodes.extend([sourceNode, targetNode])
		edges.append({'id': 'xy-edge__%s-%s'%(sourceNode['id'], targetNode['id']), 'data': {'type': 'edge', 'rawData': nodeInfo}, 'source': sourceNode['id'], 'target': targetNode['id'], 'label': '%s %s'%(round(nodeInfo['lotEventQty'], 1), nodeInfo['itemUnitName'])})
		if itemSourceName == 'input':
			processedNodes[lotNode['id']]['data']['nodeQty'] -= nodeInfo['lotEventQty']
			if lotAssetStr not in targetedNodes: targetedNodes.append(lotAssetStr)
		else:
			if not processedNodes[lotNode['id']]['data'].has_key('nodeQty'): processedNodes[lotNode['id']]['data']['nodeQty'] = 0	
			processedNodes[lotNode['id']]['data']['nodeQty'] += nodeInfo['lotEventQty']
		
		return
	########################################################################
	def generateEdgesDict(edges):
		outgoing, incoming = {}, {}
		
		for e in edges:
			outgoing.setdefault(e['source'], []).append(e['target'])
			incoming.setdefault(e['target'], []).append(e['source'])
		
		return outgoing, incoming
	########################################################################
	def getNodeSource(lotAssetStr):
		# This function will determine if a lot node already exists to start an input lot event from. If there are multiple matching nodes, then we will pick the first one that is active and has a qty of > 0
		
		matchingLotNodes = [processedNodes[key] for key in processedNodes.keys() if lotAssetStr in key]
		nodes = sorted(matchingLotNodes, key=lambda x: x['data']['seqNum'])
		
		for node in nodes:
#			if node['data']['nodeQty'] > 0: return node['id']
			if node['data']['nodeQty'] != 0: return node['id']
		return lotAssetStr
	########################################################################
	def getSequenceNumber(lotAssetStr):
		matchList = [processedNodes[nodeId]['data']['seqNum'] for nodeId in processedNodes.keys() if lotAssetStr in nodeId]
		return max(matchList) if len(matchList) > 0 else 0
	########################################################################
	def detectCycle(loeNodeId, lotNodeId, previousLotNodeId):
		'''
		Return True if adding edge loeNodeId -> lotNodeId would create a cycle.	This happens if loeNodeId is reachable from lotNodeId in the current graph, 	or if the lot repeats immediately.
		'''
		if previousLotNodeId == lotNodeId: return True

		outgoing = {}
		for e in edges: outgoing.setdefault(e['source'], []).append(e['target'])

		# Is loe reachable from lot? If yes, adding loe->lot closes the loop.
		stack = [lotNodeId]
		visited = set([lotNodeId])

		while stack:
			n = stack.pop()
			if n == loeNodeId: 	return True
			for nxt in outgoing.get(n, []):
				if nxt not in visited:
					visited.add(nxt)
					stack.append(nxt)

		return False
	########################################################################
	def sortLotEvents(lotEvents):
		'''
		Sorts the data so that input events are processed first, in the case that its corresponding output event would come in the lotEvents dataset first
		'''
		
		lotEvents = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(lotEvents)
		inputLots = [row['lotOperationEventId'] for row in lotEvents if row['itemSourceName'] == 'input']
		sortedRows = []
		for row in lotEvents: 
			if row['lotOperationEventId'] not in inputLots: sortedRows.append(row)
		
		for row in lotEvents: 
			if row['lotOperationEventId'] in inputLots: sortedRows.append(row)
		
		return sortedRows
	########################################################################
	def removeDuplicateEvents(data):
		'''
		Combine lot events that share the same identifying columns into one row by summing lotEventQty. Preserves original order by keeping the first occurrence of each group. If no dupes exist, returns data unchanged.
		'''
		targetColumns = ['lotOperationEventId', 'lotOperationId', 'operationtStamp', 'tStamp', 'lotId', 'assetId', 'itemSourceId', 'itemId']
	
		acc = {}		# key -> {'row': firstRow, 'qty': sumQty}
		hasDupes = False
	
		for row in data:
			key = tuple(row[c] for c in targetColumns)
			if key in acc:
				acc[key]['qty'] += row['lotEventQty']
				hasDupes = True
			else: acc[key] = {'row': row, 'qty': row['lotEventQty']}
	
		if not hasDupes: return data
	
		finalRows = []
		seen = set()
		for row in data:
			key = tuple(row[c] for c in targetColumns)
			if key in seen: continue
			seen.add(key)
			out = dict(acc[key]['row'])
			out['lotEventQty'] = acc[key]['qty']
			finalRows.append(out)
	
		return finalRows
	########################################################################
	def removeDuplicateNodes(nodes):
		# For some reason duplicate nodes are being generated, so here we'll filter out the extras
		
		uniqueNodeIds, 	uniqueNodes = [], []
		for node in nodes:
			if node['id'] not in uniqueNodeIds:
				uniqueNodeIds.append(node['id'])
				uniqueNodes.append(node)
		
		return uniqueNodes
	########################################################################
	def buildLotAssetStr(nodeInfo):
		return "lot-%s-%s-%s"%(nodeInfo['lotId'], nodeInfo['assetId'], (nodeInfo['lotStateName'] or '') + '-' + (nodeInfo['lotStateReasonName'] or ''))
	########################################################################
	
	if lotEvents is None: return {"nodes": [], "edges": []}

	deviceUTCOffsetMins = int(self.session.props.device.timezone.utcOffset * 60.0)	
	nodes, processedNodes, edges, targetedNodes, qtyDict = [], {}, [], [], {}	
	previousLotNodeId = None
	sortedLotData = removeDuplicateEvents(sortLotEvents(lotEvents))	
	for row in sortedLotData:		
		loeNode = createLoeNode(row)
		lotNode = createLotNode(row, loeNode, previousLotNodeId)
		processEvent(row['itemSourceName'], lotNode, loeNode, row)
		updateLotNodeDisplay(lotNode['id'])

	nodes = removeDuplicateNodes(nodes)
	sortedNodes = self.getNodeLayout(nodes, edges)
		
	return {'nodes': sortedNodes, 'edges': edges}
